title: Smoked Paella with Fish and Dum
description: A unique fusion dish combining the flavors of Spanish paella with the Asian dum and a smoky twist.

ingredients.name: Aromatic Spices (such as cumin and coriander)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Portuguese sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish pieces and cook until opaque, about 5 minutes.
Add the paella rice and stir to combine with the sausage and fish.
Add the smoked paprika, aromatic spices, and dum broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add the dum to the pan and continue to simmer for another 5 minutes.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.
Note: If using a gas stovetop, cook the paella over high heat to achieve the characteristic crispy crust at the bottom.
If using an electric stovetop, cook the paella over medium-high heat to prevent the rice from burning.
If using a grill, cook the paella over medium-high heat, rotating the pan every 5 minutes to achieve even cooking.
